definitions.explanation: A system of interconnected communication lines and facilities for transmitting information. Covers telephone networks, internet infrastructure, broadcast networks, and other communication systems.

examples.japanese: {通信網|つうしんもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{通信網|つうしんもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寸断|すんだん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The communication network was disrupted by the disaster.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧{通信網|つうしんもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦リモートワーク→リモートワーク：06095_rimootowaaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧になった。
examples.english: The spread of high-speed communication networks has made remote work possible even in rural areas.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧ (communication) + {網|もう} (network, net). Used in news, business, and technical contexts. The {網|もう} suffix appears in many network-related compounds such as {交通網|こうつうもう} (transportation network) and {電話網|でんわもう} (telephone network).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信網|つうしんもう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}する→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧ (to develop a communication network)
- {通信網|つうしんもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寸断|すんだん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (network is disrupted)
- ⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧{通信網|つうしんもう} (high-speed communication network)
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧{通信網|つうしんもう} (nationwide communication network)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{回線|かいせん}→回線：11094_kaisen⟧: line, circuit — a single communication line or channel
- ⟦ネットワーク→ネットワーク：04759_nettowaaku⟧: network — the loanword equivalent, used more casually
